#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

class Reader {
    static istream* reader;
    static stringstream tokenizer;
 
    /** call this method to initialize reader for InputStream */
    static void init(istream& input) {
        reader = &input;
        tokenizer.str("");
    }
 
    /** get next word */
    
    static string next() {
        while ( ! tokenizer.str().size() ) {
            //TODO add check for eof if necessary
            *reader >> tokenizer;
        }
        return tokenizer.str();
    }
 
    static int nextInt() {
        return stoi( next() );
    }
    static long nextLong() {
        return stol( next() );
    }
    static double nextDouble() {
        return stod( next() );
    }
};

int main() {
    Reader::init(cin);
    int n=Reader::nextInt();
    int b=Reader::nextInt();
    vector<int> arr(n+1);
    vector<int> oddcount(n+1);
    vector<int> evencount(n+1);
    for(int i=1;i<=n;i++) {
        arr[i]=Reader::nextInt();
        if(arr[i]%2==1) {
            oddcount[i]=oddcount[i-1]+1;
            evencount[i]=evencount[i-1];
        }
        else {
            oddcount[i]=oddcount[i-1];
            evencount[i]=evencount[i-1]+1;
        }
    }
    int cut=0;
    vector<int> arr2(n/2-1);
    for(int i=2;i<n;i+=2) {
        if(oddcount[i]==evencount[i]) {
            arr2[i/2-1]=abs(arr[i]-arr[i+1]);
        }
        else {
            arr2[i/2-1]=-1;
        }
    }
    sort(arr2.begin(), arr2.end());
    long sum=0;
    for(int i=0;i<n/2-1;i++) {
        if(arr2[i]!=-1 && sum+arr2[i]<=b) {
            cut++;
            sum+=arr2[i];
        }
    }
    cout << cut << endl;
    return 0;
}
